checks.description: The workbook's Checks rows against Fyniq's.

checks_differ.description: The workbook's checks whose status Fyniq's do not share.

checks_run_at.description: When Fyniq's checks last ran; absent when they never did.

differences.description: The figures that differ, by account, month and figure: the difference register's lines.

ledger_revision.description: The ledger revision Fyniq's figures were read at (ENG-46).

not_compared.description: What M4's parity asks for that the report does not compare yet.

items.description: gst_f5: the last GST F5 return against the workbook's GST Return sheet, until Fyniq makes the F5 return (p1-gst).

path.description: The path imported: history compares the opening and each month's movement and closing; clean_start the opening against the workbook's closing at its as-of.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the report's figures, checks and decisions (not its status, revision, run time or sign-off): what the Accountant's sign-off names, and the ETag (design D8).

sign_off.description: The latest sign-off of the report and its register; absent before the first.

status.description: not_committed: the import is not committed yet, so there is nothing to reconcile and the report holds no figures; ready: the report of the books as they stand; signed: the Accountant signed this report and its register (M4).

through.description: The last month compared: the workbook's as-of.

undecided.description: The register's lines without a decision that counts: the differences, and the checks whose status differs. The sign-off needs none.
